title: Review pass (2026-08-01): fig02/fig03 finalized, fig04 four-area rebuild in progress, root-level repo reorg, skill/graph audit
notes: fig02 (spiking exemplar rasters): iterated to final spec across this session -- black raster dots, per-column PSTH row (all 4 R-family conditions overlaid, colour-coded, epoch-shaded, black dashed onset lines at p1-p4), S- resampled to exactly 40 trials with replacement when fewer are available, O++ column manually overridden to unit 51/FEF/sub-C31o_ses-230823 (documented as a display-only override, not a reclassification), column titles/x-axis labels swapped top/bottom and aligned to real axes bounding boxes, suptitle removed in favour of caption.md. Regenerated cleanly each pass (script exits 0, receipt/stats files written). Copied to context/figures/fig02_finalized.svg/.png per user direction -- status: locked.

fig03 (unit census): panel A (presence-by-area) merged FST into MST, redefined 'stable' from the upstream drift-keep-fraction screen to a directly-computed trial_presence_fraction > 0.98 (>=1 spike in that fraction of a session's correct trials, computed fresh in scripts/compute_unit_trial_presence.py rather than reusing a differently-defined upstream field), added per-segment n= labels, moved legend to top and dropped the subtitle. Panel B (composition8-by-area) relabelled Null->Other for display only (undelying bucket unchanged), dropped its subtitle. Panel C (RXRR template trace) split into two subplots (S-family: S++/S-- pooled into S+/S-; O-family: O-/O+/O++ with a flat dashed 0.5 a.u. reference line standing in for Null, not a real Null trace), SEM bands removed in favour of Gaussian-smoothed traces only (sigma=3 bins S-family, sigma=6 bins O-family), y-axis changed from raw rate to per-class min-max-scaled a.u. Whitespace tightened repeatedly (inter-panel gap 10pt->1pt, label-inset instead of a dedicated header row) -- final height 548.1pt down from 735.7pt at first assembly. One real bug was caught and fixed mid-session: the Null->Other rename silently zeroed a stats contingency-table column via a stale key lookup, caught by the resulting chi2_contingency ValueError, not a review pass. Copied to context/figures/fig03_finalized.svg/.png -- status: locked.

fig04 (V1/V3a-d/TEO/PFC condition TFR): expanded from a V1/PFC-only build (a real scope gap against CLAUDE.md's stated 4-area plan, confirmed by user decision to expand rather than re-scope the doc) to the full 4-area x 4-column (16-panel) layout; per-spectrogram colour scale changed from one shared 99th-percentile |dB| limit to each panel autoscaled to itself (receipt field renamed colour_scale_db -> colour_scale_db_per_panel accordingly). Gaussian smoothing added to both the spectrogram maps (2-D, sigma 1.5 time / 1.0 freq bins, gouraud shading) and the band traces (1-D, sigma 2 time bins) -- cosmetic only, explicitly noted in both docstrings that no statistic reads the smoothed arrays. A fig04.png export step was added (copies the single assembled panel's already-rendered matplotlib PNG rather than re-rasterizing the SVG). NOT YET SEALED: as of this node, the rebuild that picks up the smoothing + per-panel-vlim + PNG changes together has not finished on disk -- context/figures/fig04_v1_pfc_condition_tfr/fig04.svg on disk is stale (predates the smoothing change), and a fig04.png/fig04_finalized.png has not yet been produced via any renderer, headless-browser or otherwise. Two background runs of this script hung for 7-23 hours with zero output before being force-killed this session; a third run is in progress and, unlike the first two, is showing steady memory growth (not the flat zero-progress signature the first two showed before being killed) -- most likely the first two really were hung (Windows h5py/HDF5 file-handle release lag after a hard kill, or genuine lock contention with a concurrent agent session also reading the same NWB files), not merely slow-and-buffered like the third.
